text:
maya: Quick heads-up — PR #9184 (runtime/latency-fix) is blocking tonight's 18:00 PT cut. We need 2x approvers (infra + ml-ops) before cutoff. CI is mostly green but a staging smoke test flaked once. Can people ping if they can take an approve? link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/9184

raj: I can do the infra review, looking now :eyes:

kevin: I'm oncall until 16:30 PT, then free. I can take the ml-ops signoff after my 30m meeting (around 16:45).

sam: FYI the staging run failed on the `serve_kv_cache_smoke` test once, stack: `IndexError` in warmup routine. Re-ran and passed. Pasted snippet below:
```
--- FAIL: serve_kv_cache_smoke (0.32s)
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "tests/smoke/test_warmup.py", line 42, in test_kv
    assert warmup()
IndexError: pop from empty list
```

nora: Is this high-risk? If it's only a defensive null-check, maybe 1x is ok and we do a post-cut followup?

maya: Policy on release branch still requires 2x. It's a runtime change touching cache handling — we prefer infra + ml-ops eyes. If we miss cutoff there is an automated rollback plan but we'd rather avoid it.

raj: Reviewing files: looks like a safe guard but touches the hot path. Left one nit about a micro-alloc. If that change is small I'm fine to LGTM after CI passes again.

ci-bot: CircleCI #9184/branch build: linux ✅, macOS ✅, staging smoke: flaky (1/3). Re-run queued.

kevin: Saw the nit, pushed a tiny follow-up to address the allocation, but didn't change logic. @maya @raj please re-check when you have a moment.

maya: Thanks @kevin — re-run CI now.

ci-bot: CircleCI re-run completed: all checks passed.

raj: LGTM — approving now. :thumbsup:

kevin: LGTM. Approving. :shipit:

deploy-bot: NOTE: Merge window closes at 18:00 PT. If merged, deploy will start at 18:05 PT with canary & 15min watch.

maya: Merging in ~5 once the branch protection check clears. Thanks all.

sam: Left a small post-merge task to add a unit test for the warmup edge case. Filing TODO in the PR description.

nora: Great — appreciate the quick turnaround.

maya: Merge done. changelog: runtime: guard kv warmup (PR #9184) — rolling canary. Will monitor metrics.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: canary stage at 18:05 PT. Monitoring targets: p50 latency, error-rate.

maya: I'll watch dashboards for 30m then promote if stable. If anything spikes we have rollback at +20m.

kevin: Thanks folks — excellent team play.

raj: Good job.

ci-bot: Post-deploy smoke: all green.

maya: Closing thread. :heavy_check_mark:
